description:
Pastors James Rafferty, John Lomacang, and Daniel Morikone tackle challenging questions from Scripture. Learn about Jacob and Esau, life before Adam and Eve, Sabbath timing, Jesus’ death and resurrection, the Three Angels’ Messages, remarriage, handling injustice, and more. 

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org

1 .Was Jacob guilty of Covetousness in Genesis 25:29-34? If so, why does the Bible remain silent about it while only pointing to Esau's nonchalance about the birthright? Jacob was clearly profiting from his covetousness. 
2. In Genesis 1, God created people, male and female. But then later in Genesis 2, the Word goes into detail about how God breathed life into the man. Does this mean that people were on the earth before Adam and Eve were formed? Were people on earth before Adam & Eve?
3. Is the Sabbath here on earth a "type" that points to the Great Sabbath? Which means the books are reviewed after the 1,000 years have ended, not during the 1,000 years? 
4. Could you explain how the Sabbath is calculated? I am seeking to understand the biblical and historical basis for why Saturday is recognized as the seventh day of the week. 
5. How does the red heifer in Numbers 19 relate to end-time events? I would like to explain to a church member how this relates to Jesus' second coming. I don't believe it relates, but she says it does. 
6. How was Jesus three days and nights in the heart of the earth when he died on Friday and was raised on Sunday? 
7. If the dead know nothing and are awaiting the second coming of Jesus, and there is no one in heaven or hell, can you please explain the parable of Luke 16:19-31? 
8. An employer wrongfully terminated me and also stole legal payment from me. I went through unemployment to receive benefits after being wrongfully fired, and I have a case against the boss. I am struggling with it, though, because the Bible says to turn the other cheek, don't sue, etc. Are we supposed to just get cheated and just walk away, knowing that God will take care of this in the end? What's the best way to handle being wrongfully treated?
9. I know there are two resurrections, and the Bible states all eyes will see Him. If the dead in the graves are not resurrected till the second resurrection, how do they see Him? I know the ones who are alive will be killed with the brightness of His coming. Are the ones in the grave resurrected just to see Him? How will ‘every eye see Him’ if there are two resurrections?
10. Can you elaborate on the meaning of Jeremiah 10:1-4? Am I unintentionally worshipping and or inviting the spirits of pagan deities when I decorate a tree during the Christmas holidays? 
11. If my spouse is alive, but we are divorced, and I am calling myself a Christian, can I marry again? Can you remarry after a divorce?
12. Can you explain the Three Angels' messages? Some people are saying this is not true.
